about_blocks.text: We operate with the understanding that undesired youth behavior often originates from larger family issues. Bear’s Paw Retreat has created effective solutions as a youth residential facility, based on the inclusion of the whole family to guide and rebuild the parent/child attachment. It has been our experience that once the family relationship has been rebuilt, negative youth behaviors diminish or disappear entirely. The support of all Bear’s Paw Staff in our effective youth treatment center often results in a drastic reduction of troubled teen behavior. At the “Ranch”, a genuine family experience is created by the on-site habitation of professional counselors, teachers, caring staff, and participating youth. Based on our experience, Bears Paw Retreat limits enrolment to two youth in treatment at any given time. Our policy limiting enrolment ensures our charges experience a constructive healthy environment with minimal distraction. Positive and nurturing, our youth residential treatment facility is unlike any other. The Bear’s Paw Retreat thrives in its peacefully secluded atmosphere as a welcoming home base for change.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
